summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas but needs targeted cleanup of immune lineage modules, rare endocrine coverage, and endothelial contrast design.

issues.description: The endocrine branch includes beta, alpha, delta, PP/gamma, and epsilon cells, but lacks the rare enterochromaffin/serotonergic endocrine population reported in human pancreatic/islet datasets.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an enterochromaffin/serotonergic endocrine module with canonical markers such as TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1, TAC1, LMX1A, and endocrine markers as appropriate, then add a gated axis under endocrine_common contrasted against sibling endocrine modules.

issues.description: The T/NK module includes strong NK/cytotoxic markers while a separate NK/cytotoxic module uses nearly the same program, and the gated T and NK axes do not contrast against each other.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the T-cell module T-lineage specific, keep cytotoxic genes in the NK/cytotoxic module, and include T and NK modules as mutual negatives in their gated leukocyte axes.

issues.description: b_plasma_cell mixes B-cell and plasma-cell markers while plasma_cell separately captures plasma cells, making the B-cell axis partially redundant and less lineage-specific.
issues.suggested_fix: Convert b_plasma_cell into a cleaner B-cell module by removing plasma genes and adding supported B-cell markers such as CD19, CD22, CD74, HLA-DRA, TCL1A, or MS4A1-centered markers; keep plasma_cell as the plasma-cell module and make the axes mutual negatives.

issues.description: The dendritic module combines cDC2, cDC1, and pDC markers into one axis. A broad DC axis is acceptable, but this loses meaningful immune resolution in an otherwise fairly high-dimensional pancreas embedding.
issues.suggested_fix: Either narrow this module to a broad antigen-presenting DC program without subtype-exclusive markers, or split it into cDC and pDC axes if supporting resources justify the added dimensionality.

issues.description: The endothelial module is pan-endothelial/blood-endothelial leaning, but the lymphatic contrast uses it directly as the negative even though lymphatic endothelial cells also express pan-endothelial genes.
issues.suggested_fix: Refactor to a vascular endothelial common gate plus separate blood endothelial and lymphatic modules, or make the negative module explicitly blood-endothelial rather than pan-endothelial.

out_of_scope: Citation and DOI validation were not rechecked; this review only judged biological coverage, marker plausibility, and structural fit.
